headline: Trump and Xi agree humans must take part in military decisions involving AI: Bessent
summary: The COP31 climate conference in Turkey extended negotiations on Friday. Divisions remain substantial over fossil fuels and financing for developing countries.
why: Climate agreements shape future carbon regulation and energy transition policy, which affects fossil fuel producers, utilities and clean energy investment.
original_headline: Trump y Xi coinciden en que los humanos deben participar en decisiones militares con IA: Bessent
